text: Professional level and duration of study: It is an undergraduate major in regular institutions of higher learning, belonging to the category of economics and trade. The duration of study is usually four years, and upon graduation, a Bachelor of Economics degree will be awarded.Training objective Cultivate students with good ideological qualities and moral norms, who can systematically master the basic knowledge, theories and methods of economics and trade, be familiar with international common economic and trade rules, understand and grasp the operation mechanisms and development laws of domestic and foreign economies and trade, be proficient in using one foreign language, and be skilled in applying modern information technology. Application-oriented, compound and international talents with good communication and coordination skills as well as an innovative and entrepreneurial spirit.
